paragraphs.heading: Finding redemptive themes
paragraphs.edited: A fun way to do this is to find different stories, whether it be your own story, or maybe some of their stories, or the story of someone you know. It could be a book; it could be a movie. But within those stories you want to find redemptive themes, themes of salvation, those kinds of things. And you'd be surprised how many different stories are actually based off of, or have buried within them, biblical themes.
